SELECT uc.* FROM la_user_course uc LEFT JOIN la_user u ON u.id = uc.user_id LEFT JOIN la_student s ON s.id = uc.student_id AND s.delete_time IS NULL LEFT JOIN la_course_class c ON c.id = uc.course_class_id
uc.delete_time IS NULL
AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.studentName}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.studentName}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.studentName}, '%'))
AND u.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.mobile}, '%')
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.className}, '%')
AND uc.status = #{q.status}
ORDER BY uc.id DESC
